title: A Quick Reply
text:
Hi Lucy, thanks for your email! I am sorry I did not reply earlier. I was busy with work this week.

Can we meet on Saturday? I want to see your new house. Let me know what time is good for you. See you soon, Ana.

questions.text: Why did Ana not reply earlier?
options: She did not get the email

questions.text: What does Ana want to see on Saturday?
What is the relationship between Ana and Lucy?
What kind of email is this?

vocabulary.definition: having a lot of work or things to do
to write or say something back to someone
to see someone in person at an agreed time and place
feeling regret about something you did or did not do

paragraph_translations: Oi, Lucy, obrigada pelo seu e-mail! Desculpe por não ter respondido antes. Eu estive ocupada com o trabalho esta semana.
Podemos nos encontrar no sábado? Quero ver sua casa nova. Me avise qual horário é bom para você. Até logo, Ana.
